_comment: Formation shapes. max_files is the width the shape is willing to spread to - it is the single number that distinguishes a wide shape from a deep one, and every other geometric consequence follows from it. spacing_multiplier scales the shared base spacing, so LOOSE is genuinely looser rather than merely relabelled. These values describe geometry and movement only; nothing here is a combat bonus. A future shield wall or pike phalanx is another entry in this table plus its own mechanics, not a rewrite.

formations.name: Line
formations.description: Wide and shallow. The default fighting shape: maximum frontage, minimum depth.

formations.name: Column
formations.description: Narrow and deep. For moving down a road, through a gap, or turning a flank.

formations.name: Loose
formations.description: Open order with room between soldiers. Harder to disorder, slower to dress.
